faq_section.desc: Takriim is an all-in-one SaaS platform that lets you manage your business smoothly from one place.

items.question: What pricing plans are available?
items.answer: The system offers three flexible plans: Small, Medium, and Large, based on the number of products and daily sales volume, suitable for all business sizes.

items.question: Can I upgrade or change my plan later?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or change your plan at any time easily without losing any data.

items.question: What core services does the system include?
items.answer: The system includes daily sales tracking, daily and monthly accounting closure, inventory management, debts, and expenses through a single dashboard.

items.question: Is the system secure and are data backups handled regularly?
items.answer: Absolutely. The system provides high-level security with continuous monitoring and regular data backups.

items.question: Is technical support available?
items.answer: Yes, all plans include continuous technical support to assist you anytime and ensure business continuity.
